class.name: WebTextArea
class.brief_description: A control that mirrors the HTML [code]<textarea>[/code] element, including its attributes, default styling and editing behavior.
class.description: [WebTextArea] reproduces an HTML [code]<textarea>[/code] as a Godot [Control]. Its intrinsic size follows Chromium: [member cols] columns of the font's column width plus room for a vertical scrollbar, and [member rows] lines of the [code]normal[/code] line height, inside a 1px border and 2px padding. [member Control.size] corresponds to the CSS border box. The default font is the browser's default fixed-pitch family for [member font_locale] (for example MingLiU for zh-TW and Consolas for English on Windows). Editing happens in an embedded [TextEdit]; scrollbars, the scroll corner, the resize grip and the focus ring are drawn to match the browser. [b]Attributes.[/b] [member cols], [member rows], [member wrap_mode], [member disabled], [member readonly], [member placeholder], [member autofocus], [member maxlength], [member minlength] and [member required] behave like their HTML counterparts. [member maxlength] limits what the user can type or paste, counted in UTF-16 code units with each line break counting once. [b]Forms.[/b] [method get_form_value] returns the submitted value (wrapped lines become line breaks when [member wrap_mode] is [constant WRAP_HARD]); [method reset] restores [member default_value]; [method get_validity] reports the constraint-validation state. [b]Styling.[/b] Use [method set_css] for author declarations (box, typography, [code]resize[/code]).

method.name: apply_autofocus
method.description: Focuses the field when [member autofocus] is set and the control can take focus, as a page load does. Returns [code]true[/code] when focus is requested.

method.name: check_validity
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the value satisfies [member required], [member maxlength] and [member minlength].

method.name: clear_css
method.description: Removes every author declaration set with [method set_css] or [method set_css_text].

method.name: get_form_value
method.description: Returns the value a form submits. With [constant WRAP_HARD], every on-screen wrap becomes a line break.

method.name: get_test_metrics
method.description: Returns the resolved box model (size, border box, border, padding, font size, line height, column width, colors, scrollbar state) for comparison with the browser.

method.name: get_validity
method.description: Returns the constraint-validation state: [code]value_missing[/code], [code]too_long[/code], [code]too_short[/code], [code]length[/code] (UTF-16 code units) and [code]valid[/code]. A disabled or readonly field is never invalid; [code]too_long[/code] and [code]too_short[/code] only apply after the user edited the value.

method.name: reset
method.description: Restores [member default_value], like an HTML form reset.

method.name: set_css
method.description: Applies one author declaration. Supported: [code]background-color[/code], [code]color[/code], [code]border[/code], [code]border-width[/code], [code]border-*-width[/code], [code]border-color[/code], [code]border-style[/code], [code]border-radius[/code], [code]padding[/code], [code]padding-*[/code], [code]box-sizing[/code], [code]width[/code], [code]height[/code], [code]font-size[/code], [code]font-family[/code], [code]font-weight[/code], [code]line-height[/code], [code]letter-spacing[/code], [code]text-align[/code] and [code]resize[/code]. An empty value removes the declaration.

method.name: set_css_text
method.description: Applies an inline-style string such as [code]"font-size:16px;padding:4px"[/code].

method.name: simulate_type
method.description: Types [param text] at the caret through the same rules as the keyboard, including [member maxlength].

members.member: Focus the field when it becomes ready, like the HTML [code]autofocus[/code] attribute. See [method apply_autofocus].
Visible width in average character columns. Values below 1 fall back to 20.
The markup content that [method reset] restores.
The field cannot be focused or edited and is painted with the browser's disabled colors.
Locale whose default fixed-pitch font the field uses (the browser's [code]monospace[/code]). Empty follows the OS locale.
Explicit CSS [code]height[/code] in pixels, or [code]-1[/code] for the [member rows]-based size.
Explicit CSS [code]width[/code] in pixels, or [code]-1[/code] for the [member cols]-based size.
Maximum value length the user can enter, in UTF-16 code units; [code]-1[/code] for none.
Minimum length of a user-edited, non-empty value; [code]-1[/code] for none.
Hint text shown while the value is empty.
The value cannot be edited, but the field can be focused and its text selected.
Which edges the resize grip drags (CSS [code]resize[/code]).
Visible height in lines. Values below 1 fall back to 2.
The current value. Setting it replaces the text without recording an edit.

signal.name: user_resized
signal.description: Emitted while the user drags the resize grip, with the new border-box size.

signal.name: value_changed
signal.description: Emitted after the user edits the value, and after [method reset].

constants.constant: Lines wrap on screen; the submitted value keeps only the user's own line breaks.
Lines wrap on screen and the wraps are submitted as line breaks.
Lines do not wrap; long lines scroll horizontally.
The grip resizes both dimensions (browser default).
The grip resizes the width only.
The grip resizes the height only.

theme_items.theme_item: Font size; [code]13[/code] stands for the browser's 13.3333px.
Font; empty uses the locale's default fixed-pitch font.
Focus ring drawn over the field while it has focus.
